operators.name: 100 Degrees East Diving
operators.description: PADI 5-Star Dive Centre, family-owned since 2004. Diving, snorkeling tours, and private charters to Ang Thong Marine Park and Koh Tao.

operators.name: Coral Dive Center
operators.description: Professional PADI dive center offering scuba diving courses, fun dives, and snorkeling trips around Koh Samui and nearby islands. Experienced instructors, small group sizes, and quality equipment.

operators.name: Discovery Dive Center
operators.description: PADI 5-Star Dive Center operating 26+ years. Located at Amari Koh Samui Resort. Dive courses, fun dives, dive-and-stay packages.

operators.name: IDC Samui

operators.name: Member Diving
operators.description: Swiss-managed SSI dive center. Largest and most comfortable dive boat on Koh Samui. Small groups, multilingual instructors (EN/TH/DE).

operators.name: Silent Divers
operators.description: PADI 5-Star Dive Center with over 10 years experience. Daily dive trips, PADI courses from beginner to professional levels, snorkeling tours to Sail Rock, Koh Tao, Ang Thong Marine Park.

operators.name: The Dive Academy Samui
operators.description: PADI 5-Star Instructor Development Centre (established 2002). Full range of courses from beginner to instructor level. Professional training in small groups.
